Return of a Crazy Genius Composer

June 7, 2026

Success, fame, family…

Min Hyunseung, a genius composer who lost everything in an instant, was on the verge of death…

He wanted to live a different life, one where he could say that all of his misfortunes were not because of karma.

“How could this happen… ”

He was given another chance to live.


Translator Notes:

This is what got me started in this translation project. 

Hyunseung is a man of few words but his actions and the effect his actions have on people will leave a lasting impression.
